title: Mitsubishi Chemical Cleansui says GoQSystem order data of customers may have been exposed
date_note: Cleansui's second notice is dated 24 November; the intrusion at GoQSystem was 10 to 11 November, first notice 17 November.
geo_basis: The pages state no city for Cleansui; country only
summary: Mitsubishi Chemical Cleansui says a third party accessed the order management system of its vendor GoQSystem on 10 and 11 November, through what the notice calls a vulnerability in an inquiry form. Per GoQSystem's findings, customers (purchasers and recipients) are affected; names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and order details may have been exposed. Cleansui says GoQSystem holds no credit card data.
plain: A vendor's order system used by Cleansui's online shops was accessed by a third party. Cleansui says customers are affected and personal details may have been exposed, but no card data.
exec: A vendor breach exposed order data of customers of a brand's online shops, per Cleansui's notice.
action: Cleansui advises customers not to open links in emails or SMS messages and to check through its official contact, as relayed by Cybersecurity.com (Japan).

evidence.quote: 11月10日から11日にかけて、GoQSystem社の受注管理システムに第三者による不正アクセスが発生し、注文データの一部が持ち出された。
